messages:
maria: Heads-up 1 -- were shipping the micro-launch next week and need a compact badge/sticker kit for slides, social cards, and webinar footers. Goal: scalable icons for our three benchmark pillars + deploy flexibility and a couple of certification marks. Want small, punchy, accessible assets that scale across formats. Can design take this?

kevin: Yup we can take it. Can you bullet the exact badges (icons + short copy) and any hard brand rules up front so we dont iterate too many times?

maria: Sure: badges: latency (spark), cost (coin with down arrow), reliability (shield/heartbeat), deploy-anywhere (globe/pin). Certification marks: "Redwood Verified" and "SLA-ready". Copy: provide 1-word headline + 1-line caption (max 2 words) per badge (well produce two caption variants).

tess: Quick brand constraints: primary palette only, typography locked to system headline, avoid decorative gradients, keep min 4.5:1 contrast for text over badge backgrounds. No alternate logos inside badges. See brand doc: https://redwood.in/brand-guidelines (sticker section).

kevin: Export reqs? SVG + PNG at multiple sizes? Transparent bg?

nora: Yes: SVG masters + PNGs at 1200x1200 (for slide banners to downscale), 600x600, 300x300, and 1200x300 horizontal banner slice. Also include 32x32 favicon and optimized SVGs (single path). Exports with transparent bg where applicable.

jordan: For ad tests we need three color treatments: primary color, dark-on-light, and inverted (white-on-dark). Also create two CTA overlay badges: "Try Hosted API" and "Bring Private" (short labels).

kevin: Timeline: sketches today, vector comps tomorrow AM, full export pack Thursday EOD. Will add a one-slide preview mock for quick QA. Any legal review required?

tess: Ill do brand QA. Legal needs to sign off on "Redwood Verified" lockup  tag me when comps are uploaded.

maria: Webinar is Friday evening; Thu EOD drop is tight but doable. Please prioritize the banner slice and the badge SVGs for slide assembly.

kevin: Creating Figma file now and will add a production checklist. Link posted once ready.

figma-bot: Figma file created by kevin: https://www.figma.com/file/def456/micro-badges-sticker-kit  components: badge-frame, icon-set, caption-variants.

kevin: Production spec block: ```- Master artboard: 1200x1200 px
- Square PNG exports: 1200x1200, 600x600, 300x300 (PNG @2x where appropriate)
- Banner slice: 1200x300 px (PNG + JPG)
- Favicon: 32x32 px (PNG)
- SVG: optimized single-file exports, named for pillar + treatment
- Naming convention: badge_<pillar>_<treatment>_<size>.ext
- Deliver: SVG set, PNG zips, preview slide PNG (3-up), manifest.csv with alt-text
```

jordan: Please include two alt-text options per badge (short label + benefit). Example: "Latency  sub-ms inference" and "Latency  lower per-token cost".

maria: Affirmative. Growth will A/B caption variants so include both.

nora: Upload target: GDrive -> marketing/launch-assets/micro-badge-kit/ with manifest.csv mapping filenames to alt-text and color treatments. Ill confirm after upload.

kevin: Will ping when comps are ready for brand review. ETA: thumbnails later today, full pack Thu EOD. :paintbrush: :rocket:
